text:
maya: Heads-up — planning to deploy console UI v2.7.3 to canary at 16:00 PT. Need CDN edge purge and smoke checks. Rolling canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Who can own the smoke window?

alex: I can own smoke. Confirm branch/commit and CDN zone pls. Also any special canary headers?

maya: branch release/v2.7.3 commit abc1234, asset manifest manifest-20260317-8f9a. CloudFront dist: E123ABC45DEF. Invalidation paths: /static/v2/* and /console/index.html. No special headers, just normal canary routing.

sanjay: For CloudFront invalidation run:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E123ABC45DEF --paths "/static/v2/*" "/console/index.html"
```
Also make sure S3 cache-control is correct for index.html (short TTL).

alex: Smoke checklist (short):
- load main console page
- repo list + search
- open settings page
- run quick CI trigger flow
- check frontend 2xx ratio + JS errors
I'll post pass/fail here.

deploy-bot: [automated] deploy scheduled at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z (canary slot 1)

maya: Timing: push canary at :00, wait 10m, if ok -> 50% at :10, then full at :25. If regression -> rollback to release/v2.7.2.

ella: Rollback artifact ready: tag release/v2.7.2 (sha def5678) pinned in deploy manifest. I can run rollback if smoke fails.

rui: I'll run edge checks from eu-west, us-east, ap-south once canary is up.

alex: If smoke green by :12 I'll approve 50% at :15. If any flakes mark with :warning: and I'll trigger rollback.

maya: Invalidation sequencing: only run full edge invalidation after 50% healthy (to avoid double-invalidations). Sequence: 1) push canary 2) smoke 3) approve -> increase -> 4) invalidate static assets 5) final rollout.

sanjay: FYI invalidations incur cost — consider cache-bust for index.html, but fine for this deploy.

deploy-bot: [info] canary deploy started at 1945679010

alex: Smoke: main page loads, settings open, search ok. JS errors: 0 on sampled session. Minor CPU spike but within SLO.

rui: Edge checks: eu-west OK, us-east 200s, ap-south showing 404 for /static/v2/img/logo.svg (likely propagation).

maya: Holding before 50%. I'll re-upload the missing asset and retry.

ella: Re-uploaded missing asset at 1945679300, checksum matches.

deploy-bot: [info] canary at 10% healthy -> scaled to 50% at 1945679400

alex: Re-check after 50%: files resolved, no 404s now. Approving full rollout.

maya: Running invalidation now:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E123ABC45DEF --paths "/console/index.html" "/static/v2/*"
```
Will post invalidation id.

deploy-bot: [info] cloudfront invalidation created id I2ABCDEF45 (started 1945679501)

maya: Starting final rollout -> full at 1945679600. ETA ~5m. Rollback plan ready.

alex: Monitoring: no error spikes, 2xx ratio stable, no UX regressions. LGTM.

ella: Staying on call for 30m in case of rollback.

maya: Rollout complete at 1945679800. Closing thread. :tada:
